name: Better Audio Clarity
description: A mastering chain for Minecraft's sound: a gentle leveling compressor, global EQ, a two-band harshness tamer and a lookahead limiter, loud-sound taming and a measured rebalance of accidentally loud sounds, music that skips the chain and steps back in game, and one Master Volume in dB. Settings in Music & Sound or Mod Menu; meters in Music & Sound and on the HUD. Client-side only.
